description: Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government- Appointments under the Notaries Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette contains appointments of Notaries Public made by the Minister of Public Administration under the Notaries Ordinance. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves appointments of legal professionals (notaries) who perform specific legal functions within judicial zones, making it a Type 9 classification rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
